surface_verification.justification: Playwright on the isolated stack drives the org page proposals window: rejected:/decision: learning proposals show the confirmed operator words, a missing record shows the fail-closed notice, and the learning label chips are shown.

behaviors.behavior: rejected:/decision: pointers parse with leadwright's exact regexes, mirrored server+client, bounded
the source is named in plain words (reason for rejecting / note on ADR)
positional reading: the lead's own line is never the operator's reason, note only in the countersign line shape, duplicate ADR cites nothing
quote bounds 24..200 with flattening and recordable form, like leadwright
record file fails closed: missing, directory, symlink (ELOOP + Windows lstat), swapped, FIFO, oversized, grown
POST route: words only on confirmed, no-store, 400 on bad input, write guard 403/415
window shows the operator's words only on confirmed; checking, re-checking, error, unknown status show the notice
audit records the structured form, never the quote; fence/inherited record pointers read unknown
learning label chips (reach, importance, pinned, replaces), unlabelled default, unreadable warning keeps the line
edit field reads the label live as it will be logged (newline, spaces, NBSP, zero-width)
countersigned decision_log.md fixture written by the real writer, byte-identical and hash-pinned; org page e2e
